entries.name: ClassicalMechanics.DampedHarmonicOscillator
entries.docstring:
Placeholder structure for the damped harmonic oscillator.
  The damped harmonic oscillator is specified by a mass `m`, a spring constant `k`,
  and a damping coefficient `γ`. All parameters are assumed to be positive (or non-negative
  for the damping coefficient).
entries.snippet:
structure DampedHarmonicOscillator where
  m : ℝ
  k : ℝ
  γ : ℝ
  m_pos : 0 < m
  k_pos : 0 < k
  γ_nonneg : 0 ≤ γ

entries.name: ClassicalMechanics.DampedHarmonicOscillator.EquationOfMotion
entries.docstring:
The equation of motion for the damped harmonic oscillator.

A function `x : Time → ℝ` is a solution if it satisfies

    S.m * x¨ + S.γ * ẋ + S.k * x = 0

for all times `t`.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def EquationOfMotion (x : Time → ℝ) : Prop

entries.name: ClassicalMechanics.DampedHarmonicOscillator.energyDissipationRate
entries.docstring:
Energy dissipation rate along a trajectory `x : Time → ℝ`.

  if `x` satisfies `S.equationOfMotion x`, then

  Time.deriv (S.energy x) t = - S.γ * (Time.deriv x t)^2,

so the energy is non-increasing and not conserved when `S.γ > 0`.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def energyDissipationRate (x : Time → ℝ) : Time → ℝ

entries.name: ClassicalMechanics.HarmonicOscillator.InitialConditionsAtTime
entries.docstring:
Initial conditions for the harmonic oscillator specified at an arbitrary time `t₀`.

  This structure allows specifying the position and velocity at any time `t₀`, not necessarily
  at `t=0`. This is useful for problems where the natural reference time is not zero.

  The conditions can be converted to the standard `InitialConditions` format (at `t=0`)
  using the `toInitialConditions` function.
entries.snippet:
structure InitialConditionsAtTime where
  t₀ : Time
  x_t₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 1)
  v_t₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 1)

entries.name: ClassicalMechanics.HarmonicOscillator.InitialConditionsAtTime.ext
entries.snippet:
@[ext]
lemma InitialConditionsAtTime.ext {IC₁ IC₂ : InitialConditionsAtTime}
    (h1 : IC₁.t₀ = IC₂.t₀) (h2 : IC₁.x_t₀ = IC₂.x_t₀) (h3 : IC₁.v_t₀ = IC₂.v_t₀) :
    IC₁ = IC₂

entries.name: ClassicalMechanics.HarmonicOscillator.InitialConditionsAtTime.toInitialConditions
entries.docstring:
Convert initial conditions at time `t₀` to standard initial conditions at `t=0`.

  This conversion uses the harmonic oscillator solution formula with time-reversal.
  The resulting `InitialConditions` will produce a trajectory that passes through
  `x_t₀` with velocity `v_t₀` at time `t₀`.

  See `toInitialConditions_trajectory_at_t₀` and `toInitialConditions_velocity_at_t₀` for
  the correctness proofs.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def toInitialConditions (S : HarmonicOscillator)
    (IC : InitialConditionsAtTime) : InitialConditions where

entries.name: ClassicalMechanics.HarmonicOscillator.InitialConditionsAtTime.toInitialConditions_trajectory_at_t₀
entries.docstring:
The trajectory resulting from `toInitialConditions` passes through the specified
  position `x_t₀` at time `t₀`.
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma toInitialConditions_trajectory_at_t₀ (S : HarmonicOscillator)
    (IC : InitialConditionsAtTime) :
    (IC.toInitialConditions S).trajectory S IC.t₀ = IC.x_t₀

entries.name: ClassicalMechanics.HarmonicOscillator.InitialConditionsAtTime.toInitialConditions_velocity_at_t₀
entries.docstring:
The trajectory resulting from `toInitialConditions` has the specified
  velocity `v_t₀` at time `t₀`.
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma toInitialConditions_velocity_at_t₀ (S : HarmonicOscillator)
    (IC : InitialConditionsAtTime) :
    ∂ₜ ((IC.toInitialConditions S).trajectory S) IC.t₀ = IC.v_t₀

entries.name: ClassicalMechanics.HarmonicOscillator.InitialConditionsAtTime.toInitialConditions_energy_at_t₀
entries.docstring:
The energy of the trajectory at time `t₀` equals the energy computed from the
  initial conditions at `t₀`.
entries.snippet:
lemma toInitialConditions_energy_at_t₀ (S : HarmonicOscillator)
    (IC : InitialConditionsAtTime) :
    S.energy ((IC.toInitialConditions S).trajectory S) IC.t₀ =
    1/2 * (S.m * ‖IC.v_t₀‖^2 + S.k * ‖IC.x_t₀‖^2)

entries.name: ClassicalMechanics.Lagrangian.IsTotalTimeDerivative
entries.docstring:
A function δL(r, v, t) is a total time derivative if it can be written as d/dt F(r, t)
    for some function F that depends on position and time but not velocity.

    Mathematically: δL(r, v, t) = fderiv ℝ F (r, t) (v, 1)

    By the chain rule, this equals ∂F/∂t(r, t) + ⟨∇ᵣF(r, t), v⟩.

    This is the most general form of Lagrangian equivalence under total derivatives.
    The key point is that F must be independent of velocity.
entries.snippet:
def IsTotalTimeDerivative {n : ℕ}
    (δL : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → ℝ → ℝ) : Prop

entries.name: ClassicalMechanics.Lagrangian.isTotalTimeDerivativeVelocity
entries.docstring:
A velocity-only function that is a total time derivative must be linear in velocity.

    If δL depends only on velocity and equals d/dt F(r, t) for some F,
    then δL(v) = ⟨g, v⟩ for some constant vector g.

    This characterization comes from the requirement that:
    - d/dt F(r, t) = ∂F/∂t + ⟨∇F, ṙ⟩ = ∂F/∂t + ⟨∇F, v⟩
    - For the result to be independent of r and t, we need ∇F = g (constant) and ∂F/∂t = 0
    - Thus δL(v) = ⟨g, v⟩

    WLOG, we assume `δL 0 = 0` since constants are total derivatives (c = d/dt(c·t))
    and can be absorbed without affecting the equations of motion.
entries.snippet:
lemma isTotalTimeDerivativeVelocity {n : ℕ}
    (δL : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → ℝ)
    (hδL0 : δL 0 = 0)
    (h : IsTotalTimeDerivative (fun _ v _ => δL v)) :
    ∃ g : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n), ∀ v, δL v = ⟪g, v⟫_ℝ

entries.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.localizedComp_adjoint
entries.docstring: The adjoint of localizedComp |m⟩⟨n| is |n⟩⟨m|.
entries.snippet:
lemma localizedComp_adjoint (m n : Fin T.N) (ψ φ : T.HilbertSpace) :
    ⟪|m⟩⟨n| ψ, φ⟫_ℂ = ⟪ψ, |n⟩⟨m| φ⟫_ℂ := by
  simp only [localizedComp, LinearMap.coe_mk, AddHom.coe_mk]
  rw [inner_smul_left, inner_smul_right, inner_conj_symm]
  ring











noncomputable def hamiltonian : T.HilbertSpace →ₗ[ℂ] T.HilbertSpace :=
  T.E0 • ∑ n : Fin T.N, |n⟩⟨n| - T.t • ∑ n : Fin T.N, (|n⟩⟨n + 1| + |n + 1⟩⟨n|)








lemma hamiltonian_hermitian (ψ φ : T.HilbertSpace) :
    ⟪T.hamiltonian ψ, φ⟫_ℂ = ⟪ψ, T.hamiltonian φ⟫_ℂ := by
  simp only [hamiltonian, LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, LinearMap.coe_sum,
    Finset.sum_apply, LinearMap.add_apply]
  rw [inner_sub_left, inner_sub_right]
  congr 1
  · 
    simp only [Finset.smul_sum]
    rw [sum_inner, inner_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro n _
    simp only [inner_smul_left_eq_smul, inner_smul_right_eq_smul]
    rw [localizedComp_adjoint]
  ·

entries.snippet:

    H.gramMatrix.det = ‖H.Φ1‖ ^ 2 * ‖H.Φ2‖ ^ 2 - ‖⟪H.Φ1, H.Φ2⟫_ℂ‖ ^ 2

entries.name: TwoHiggsDoublet.gramMatrix_tr_nonneg

entries.name: TwoHiggsDoublet.gaugeGroupI_exists_fst_eq
entries.snippet:
lemma gaugeGroupI_exists_fst_eq {H : TwoHiggsDoublet} (h1 : H.Φ1 ≠ 0) :
    ∃ g : StandardModel.GaugeGroupI,
      g • H.Φ1 = (!₂[‖H.Φ1‖, 0] : HiggsVec) ∧
      (g • H.Φ2) 0 = ⟪H.Φ1, H.Φ2⟫_ℂ / ‖H.Φ1‖ ∧
      ‖(g • H.Φ2) 1‖ = Real.sqrt (H.gramMatrix.det.re) / ‖H.Φ1‖

entries.snippet:
lemma gaugeGroupI_exists_fst_eq_snd_eq {H : TwoHiggsDoublet} (h1 : H.Φ1 ≠ 0) :
    ∃ g : StandardModel.GaugeGroupI,
      g • H.Φ1 = (!₂[‖H.Φ1‖, 0] : HiggsVec) ∧
      g • H.Φ2 = (!₂[⟪H.Φ1, H.Φ2⟫_ℂ / ‖H.Φ1‖, √(H.gramMatrix.det.re) / ‖H.Φ1‖] : HiggsVec)

entries.name: TwoHiggsDoublet.gramVector
entries.docstring: A real vector containing the components of the Gram matrix in the Pauli basis.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def gramVector (H : TwoHiggsDoublet) : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3 → ℝ

entries.name: TwoHiggsDoublet.gaugeGroupI_smul_fst_gramVector
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma gaugeGroupI_smul_fst_gramVector (g : StandardModel.GaugeGroupI)
    (H : TwoHiggsDoublet) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    (g • H).gramVector μ = H.gramVector μ

entries.name: TwoHiggsDoublet.gramMatrix_eq_gramVector_sum_pauliMatrix
entries.snippet:
lemma gramMatrix_eq_gramVector_sum_pauliMatrix (H : TwoHiggsDoublet) :
    gramMatrix H = (1 / 2 : ℝ) • ∑ μ, H.gramVector μ • PauliMatrix.pauliMatrix μ

entries.name: TwoHiggsDoublet.gramMatrix_eq_component_gramVector
entries.snippet:
lemma gramMatrix_eq_component_gramVector (H : TwoHiggsDoublet) :
    gramMatrix H =
    !![(1 / 2 : ℂ) * (H.gramVector (Sum.inl 0) + H.gramVector (Sum.inr 2)),
      (1 / 2 : ℂ) * (H.gramVector (Sum.inr 0) - Complex.I * H.gramVector (Sum.inr 1));
      (1 / 2 : ℂ) * (H.gramVector (Sum.inr 0) + Complex.I * H.gramVector (Sum.inr 1)),
      (1 / 2 : ℂ) * (H.gramVector (Sum.inl 0) - H.gramVector (Sum.inr 2))]

entries.snippet:

    H.gramMatrix.det.re =
    (1/4 : ℝ) * (H.gramVector (Sum.inl 0) ^ 2 -
    ∑ μ : Fin 3, H.gramVector (Sum.inr μ) ^ 2)

entries.name: TwoHiggsDoublet.gramVector_inr_sum_sq_le_inl

    ∑ μ : Fin 3, H.gramVector (Sum.inr μ) ^ 2 ≤ H.gramVector (Sum.inl 0) ^ 2

entries.name: TwoHiggsDoublet.gramVector_surjective

lemma gramVector_surjective (v : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3 → ℝ)
    (h_inl : 0 ≤ v (Sum.inl 0))

    ∃ H : TwoHiggsDoublet, H.gramVector = v

entries.name: TwoHiggsDoublet.PotentialParameters
entries.docstring:
The parameters of the Two Higgs doublet model potential.
  Following the convention of https://arxiv.org/pdf/1605.03237.
entries.snippet:
structure PotentialParameters where
  m₁₁2 : ℝ
  m₂₂2 : ℝ
  m₁₂2 : ℂ
  𝓵₁ : ℝ
  𝓵₂ : ℝ
  𝓵₃ : ℝ
  𝓵₄ : ℝ
  𝓵₅ : ℂ
  𝓵₆ : ℂ
  𝓵₇ : ℂ

entries.name: TwoHiggsDoublet.PotentialParameters.ξ
entries.docstring:
A reparameterization of the parameters of the quadratic terms of the
  potential for use with the gramVector.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def ξ (P : PotentialParameters) : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3 → ℝ

entries.name: TwoHiggsDoublet.PotentialParameters.η
entries.docstring:
A reparameterization of the parameters of the quartic terms of the
  potential for use with the gramVector.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def η (P : PotentialParameters) : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3 → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3 → ℝ
  | Sum.inl 0, Sum.inl 0 => (P.𝓵₁ + P.𝓵₂ + 2 * P.𝓵₃) / 8
  | Sum.inl 0, Sum.inr 0 => (P.𝓵₆.re + P.𝓵₇.re) * (1 / 4)
  | Sum.inl 0, Sum.inr 1 => (P.𝓵₆.im + P.𝓵₇.im) * (-1 / 4)
  | Sum.inl 0, Sum.inr 2 => (P.𝓵₁ - P.𝓵₂) * (1 / 8)
  | Sum.inr 0, Sum.inl 0 => (P.𝓵₆.re + P.𝓵₇.re) * (1 / 4)
  | Sum.inr 1, Sum.inl 0 => (P.𝓵₆.im + P.𝓵₇.im) * (-1 / 4)
  | Sum.inr 2, Sum.inl 0 => (P.𝓵₁ - P.𝓵₂) * (1 / 8)

entries.name: TwoHiggsDoublet.PotentialParameters.η_symm
entries.snippet:
lemma η_symm (P : PotentialParameters) (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    P.η μ ν = P.η ν μ

entries.name: TwoHiggsDoublet.massTerm
entries.docstring: The mass term of the two Higgs doublet model potential.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def massTerm (P : PotentialParameters) (H : TwoHiggsDoublet) : ℝ

entries.name: TwoHiggsDoublet.massTerm_eq_gramVector
entries.snippet:
lemma massTerm_eq_gramVector (P : PotentialParameters) (H : TwoHiggsDoublet) :

entries.name: TwoHiggsDoublet.gaugeGroupI_smul_massTerm
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma gaugeGroupI_smul_massTerm (g : StandardModel.GaugeGroupI) (P : PotentialParameters)

entries.name: TwoHiggsDoublet.quarticTerm
entries.docstring: The quartic term of the two Higgs doublet model potential.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def quarticTerm (P : PotentialParameters) (H : TwoHiggsDoublet) : ℝ

entries.name: TwoHiggsDoublet.quarticTerm_𝓵₄_expand
entries.snippet:
lemma quarticTerm_𝓵₄_expand (P : PotentialParameters) (H : TwoHiggsDoublet) :
    H.quarticTerm P =
    1/2 * P.𝓵₁ * ‖H.Φ1‖ ^ 2 * ‖H.Φ1‖ ^ 2 + 1/2 * P.𝓵₂ * ‖H.Φ2‖ ^ 2 * ‖H.Φ2‖ ^ 2
    + P.𝓵₃ * ‖H.Φ1‖ ^ 2 * ‖H.Φ2‖ ^ 2
    + P.𝓵₄ * (⟪H.Φ1, H.Φ2⟫_ℂ * ⟪H.Φ2, H.Φ1⟫_ℂ).re
    + (1/2 * P.𝓵₅ * ⟪H.Φ1, H.Φ2⟫_ℂ ^ 2 + 1/2 * conj P.𝓵₅ * ⟪H.Φ2, H.Φ1⟫_ℂ ^ 2).re
    + (P.𝓵₆ * ‖H.Φ1‖ ^ 2 * ⟪H.Φ1, H.Φ2⟫_ℂ + conj P.𝓵₆ * ‖H.Φ1‖ ^ 2 * ⟪H.Φ2, H.Φ1⟫_ℂ).re
    + (P.𝓵₇ * ‖H.Φ2‖ ^ 2 * ⟪H.Φ1, H.Φ2⟫_ℂ + conj P.𝓵₇ * ‖H.Φ2‖ ^ 2 * ⟪H.Φ2, H.Φ1⟫_ℂ).re

entries.name: TwoHiggsDoublet.quarticTerm_eq_gramVector
entries.snippet:
lemma quarticTerm_eq_gramVector (P : PotentialParameters) (H : TwoHiggsDoublet) :
    quarticTerm P H = ∑ a, ∑ b, H.gramVector a * H.gramVector b * P.η a b

entries.name: TwoHiggsDoublet.gaugeGroupI_smul_quarticTerm
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma gaugeGroupI_smul_quarticTerm (g : StandardModel.GaugeGroupI) (P : PotentialParameters)
    (H : TwoHiggsDoublet) :
    quarticTerm P (g • H) = quarticTerm P H

entries.name: TwoHiggsDoublet.PotentialIsBounded
entries.docstring: The condition that the potential is bounded from below.
entries.snippet: def PotentialIsBounded (P : PotentialParameters) : Prop

entries.name: TwoHiggsDoublet.potentialIsBounded_iff_forall_gramVector
entries.snippet:
lemma potentialIsBounded_iff_forall_gramVector (P : PotentialParameters) :
    PotentialIsBounded P ↔ ∃ c : ℝ, ∀ K : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3 → ℝ, 0 ≤ K (Sum.inl 0) →
      ∑ μ : Fin 3, K (Sum.inr μ) ^ 2 ≤ K (Sum.inl 0) ^ 2 →
      c ≤ ∑ μ, P.ξ μ * K μ + ∑ a, ∑ b, K a * K b * P.η a b

entries.name: TwoHiggsDoublet.potentialIsBounded_iff_forall_euclid
entries.snippet:
lemma potentialIsBounded_iff_forall_euclid (P : PotentialParameters) :
    PotentialIsBounded P ↔ ∃ c, ∀ K0 : ℝ, ∀ K : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3), 0 ≤ K0 →
      ‖K‖ ^ 2 ≤ K0 ^ 2 → c ≤ P.ξ (Sum.inl 0) * K0 + ∑ μ, P.ξ (Sum.inr μ) * K μ
      + K0 ^ 2 * P.η (Sum.inl 0) (Sum.inl 0)
      + 2 * K0 * ∑ b, K b * P.η (Sum.inl 0) (Sum.inr b) +
      ∑ a, ∑ b, K a * K b * P.η (Sum.inr a) (Sum.inr b)

entries.name: TwoHiggsDoublet.potentialIsBounded_iff_forall_euclid_lt
entries.snippet:
lemma potentialIsBounded_iff_forall_euclid_lt (P : PotentialParameters) :
    PotentialIsBounded P ↔ ∃ c ≤ 0, ∀ K0 : ℝ, ∀ K : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3), 0 < K0 →
      ‖K‖ ^ 2 ≤ K0 ^ 2 → c ≤ P.ξ (Sum.inl 0) * K0 + ∑ μ, P.ξ (Sum.inr μ) * K μ
      + K0 ^ 2 * P.η (Sum.inl 0) (Sum.inl 0)
      + 2 * K0 * ∑ b, K b * P.η (Sum.inl 0) (Sum.inr b) +
      ∑ a, ∑ b, K a * K b * P.η (Sum.inr a) (Sum.inr b)

entries.name: TwoHiggsDoublet.massTermReduced
entries.docstring:
A function related to the mass term of the potential, used in the boundedness
  condition and equivalent to the term `J2` in
  https://arxiv.org/abs/hep-ph/0605184.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def massTermReduced (P : PotentialParameters) (k : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) : ℝ

entries.name: TwoHiggsDoublet.massTermReduced_lower_bound
entries.snippet:
lemma massTermReduced_lower_bound (P : PotentialParameters) (k : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3))
    (hk : ‖k‖ ^ 2 ≤ 1) : P.ξ (Sum.inl 0) - √(∑ a, |P.ξ (Sum.inr a)| ^ 2) ≤ massTermReduced P k

entries.name: TwoHiggsDoublet.quarticTermReduced
entries.docstring:
A function related to the quartic term of the potential, used in the boundedness
  condition and equivalent to the term `J4` in
  https://arxiv.org/abs/hep-ph/0605184.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def quarticTermReduced (P : PotentialParameters) (k : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) : ℝ

entries.name: TwoHiggsDoublet.potentialIsBounded_iff_exists_forall_forall_reduced
entries.snippet:
lemma potentialIsBounded_iff_exists_forall_forall_reduced (P : PotentialParameters) :
    PotentialIsBounded P ↔ ∃ c ≤ 0, ∀ K0 : ℝ, ∀ k : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3), 0 < K0 →
      ‖k‖ ^ 2 ≤ 1 → c ≤ K0 * massTermReduced P k + K0 ^ 2 * quarticTermReduced P k

entries.name: TwoHiggsDoublet.quarticTermReduced_nonneg_of_potentialIsBounded
entries.snippet:
lemma quarticTermReduced_nonneg_of_potentialIsBounded (P : PotentialParameters)
    (hP : PotentialIsBounded P) (k : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3))
    (hk : ‖k‖ ^ 2 ≤ 1) : 0 ≤ quarticTermReduced P k

entries.name: TwoHiggsDoublet.potentialIsBounded_iff_exists_forall_reduced
entries.snippet:
lemma potentialIsBounded_iff_exists_forall_reduced (P : PotentialParameters) :
    PotentialIsBounded P ↔ ∃ c, 0 ≤ c ∧ ∀ k : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3), ‖k‖ ^ 2 ≤ 1 →
      0 ≤ quarticTermReduced P k ∧
      (massTermReduced P k < 0 →
      massTermReduced P k ^ 2 ≤ 4 * quarticTermReduced P k * c)

entries.name: TwoHiggsDoublet.massTermReduced_pos_of_quarticTermReduced_zero_potentialIsBounded
entries.snippet:
lemma massTermReduced_pos_of_quarticTermReduced_zero_potentialIsBounded (P : PotentialParameters)
    (hP : PotentialIsBounded P) (k : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3))
    (hk : ‖k‖ ^ 2 ≤ 1) (hq : quarticTermReduced P k = 0) : 0 ≤ massTermReduced P k

entries.name: TwoHiggsDoublet.potentialIsBounded_iff_forall_reduced
entries.snippet:
@[sorryful]
lemma potentialIsBounded_iff_forall_reduced (P : PotentialParameters) :
    PotentialIsBounded P ↔ ∀ k : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3), ‖k‖ ^ 2 ≤ 1 →
      0 ≤ quarticTermReduced P k ∧ (quarticTermReduced P k = 0 → 0 ≤ massTermReduced P k)

entries.name: StandardModel.GaugeGroupI.ofU1Subgroup_toSU2
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma ofU1Subgroup_toSU2 (u1 : unitary ℂ) :
    toSU2 (ofU1Subgroup u1) = ⟨!![star (u1 ^ 3 : unitary ℂ), 0;0, (u1 ^ 3 : unitary ℂ)], by
    simp only [SetLike.mem_coe]
    rw [mem_unitaryGroup_iff']
    funext i j
    rw [Matrix.mul_apply]
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp [conj_mul'], by
    simp only [RCLike.star_def, SetLike.mem_coe, MonoidHom.mem_mker, coe_detMonoidHom,
      det_fin_two_of, conj_mul', mul_zero, sub_zero]
    simp⟩

entries.name: StandardModel.HiggsVec.gaugeGroupI_smul_phase_snd
entries.snippet:
lemma gaugeGroupI_smul_phase_snd (φ : HiggsVec) :
    ∃ g : StandardModel.GaugeGroupI,
      (g • φ).ofLp 1 = ‖(φ.ofLp 1)‖ ∧
      (∀ φ1 : HiggsVec, (g • φ1).ofLp 0 = φ1.ofLp 0) ∧
      (∀ a : ℝ, g • (!₂[a, 0] : HiggsVec) = (!₂[a, 0] : HiggsVec))

entries.name: realLorentzTensor.colorToComplex_append
entries.docstring: `colorToComplex` commutes with `Fin.append` (as functions).
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma colorToComplex_append {n m : ℕ}
    (c : Fin n → realLorentzTensor.Color) (c1 : Fin m → realLorentzTensor.Color) :
    (colorToComplex ∘ Fin.append c c1) = Fin.append (colorToComplex ∘ c) (colorToComplex ∘ c1)

entries.name: realLorentzTensor.prodTColorToComplex
entries.docstring:
`prodT` on the complex side, with colors written as `colorToComplex ∘ Fin.append ...`.
This is `prodT` followed by a cast using `colorToComplex_append`.

entries.name: realLorentzTensor.tau_colorToComplex

entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma tau_colorToComplex (x : realLorentzTensor.Color) :
    (complexLorentzTensor).τ (colorToComplex x) = colorToComplex ((realLorentzTensor).τ x)

entries.name: realLorentzTensor.evalIdxToComplex
entries.docstring: Convert an evaluation index from the real repDim to the complex repDim.
entries.snippet:
def evalIdxToComplex {n : ℕ}
    {c : Fin (n + 1) → realLorentzTensor.Color} (i : Fin (n + 1))
    (b : Fin ((realLorentzTensor).repDim (c i))) :
    Fin ((complexLorentzTensor).repDim ((colorToComplex ∘ c) i))

entries.name: realLorentzTensor.evalTColorToComplex
entries.docstring:
`evalT` on the complex side, but with output colors as `colorToComplex ∘ (c ∘ i.succAbove)`.
Implemented via `permT (σ := id) (by simp)` as a transport.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def evalTColorToComplex {n : ℕ}
    {c : Fin (n + 1) → realLorentzTensor.Color} (i : Fin (n + 1))
    (b : Fin ((realLorentzTensor).repDim (c i))) :
    ℂT(colorToComplex ∘ c) → ℂT(colorToComplex ∘ (c ∘ i.succAbove))
